filmschool.title: Google Flow + Veo: AI filmmaking built around prompts, reference clips, and Flow TV prompt breakdowns
filmschool.description: Google's Flow creative studio pairs Veo video generation with Gemini prompting and a Flow TV showcase that reveals prompts and techniques creators can study and adapt for film-school style learning.

filmschool.title: Veo 3.1 Ingredients to Video adds richer dialogue, character consistency, and mobile-first creative controls
filmschool.description: Google upgraded Veo 3.1 Ingredients to Video so creators can turn reference images into expressive videos with stronger dialogue, backgrounds, and character continuity.

filmschool.title: Google I/O 2026 used Gemini and Flow to prototype animations, sports action, and a short film
filmschool.description: Google shared how Gemini Omni, Veo, and Flow helped build I/O 2026 visuals, including generated animations and a short film concept starring TPUs preparing for heavy lifting.

filmschool.title: Google Flow positions itself as an AI creative studio for cinematic video, images, and custom tools
filmschool.description: The Flow product page frames the platform as a hands-on creative workspace for transforming ideas into cinematic videos with Google's generative models.

industry.title: Meta and Reliance announce India's first Meta AI-enabled data center
industry.description: Meta will lease a Reliance AI-enabled data center in India, bringing AI infrastructure closer to one of its fastest-growing communities and supporting global AI compute needs.

industry.title: Runway partners with Getty Images for enterprise-ready AI video tooling
industry.description: Runway and Getty Images are building a Runway Getty Images Model that gives enterprise customers a licensed baseline for custom video-generation models and fine-tuning.

industry.title: Amazon MGM Studios greenlights AI series through its GenAI Creators' Fund
industry.description: Amazon MGM Studios unveiled a GenAI Creators' Fund with funding and AI production tools on AWS, including new AI-series deals from established producers.

industry.title: Real-time AI video startup Reactor raises $59M from WndrCo and others
industry.description: Reactor, founded by ex-Apple engineers, raised $59M to push real-time AI video workflows for interactive and production-scale creative teams.

tools.title: Google launches Veo 3.1 Lite for lower-cost, high-volume AI video generation
tools.description: Veo 3.1 Lite is positioned for builders needing faster, cheaper text-to-video and image-to-video generation with landscape and portrait outputs.

tools.title: Kling Video 3.0 introduces AI Director, native audio, multi-shot composition, and 15-second output
tools.description: Kling's Video 3.0 update adds automated multi-shot composition, complex camera moves, synchronized multilingual sound, and stronger text rendering for creator workflows.

tools.title: Pika adds MCP and agent-style workflows for AI video creation
tools.description: Pika's updated platform emphasizes agents, workflow automation, trend creation, and model access for creators and developers.

tools.title: Runway's AI video stack keeps expanding with enterprise licensing and custom model pathways
tools.description: Runway's Getty Images partnership points toward enterprise-grade licensed models, custom fine-tuning, and more controlled video-generation pipelines.

niches.title: A2E AI catalogs video use cases for education, product demos, avatars, training, and campaigns
niches.description: A2E's use-case pages highlight practical vertical applications, including AI video for education, talking photos, training content, and social media campaigns.

niches.title: AI product video becomes a scalable ecommerce funnel tactic
niches.description: New ecommerce guides show AI video being used to create product demos, ad variations, and conversion-focused clips from product images and brief prompts.

niches.title: AI video for real estate moves from listing photos to cinematic property reels
niches.description: Real-estate marketing guides show agents using AI to turn property photos into short-form reels, listing videos, and brand-building social clips.

niches.title: AI video is becoming core infrastructure for Reels and TikTok content
niches.description: Vertical-video guides argue that AI generation and enhancement are now central to fast-moving short-form content workflows on Reels and TikTok.

offers.title: Runway pricing starts at $12/month with free, Standard, Pro, and Max plans
offers.description: Runway's current pricing page lists flexible AI image and video plans with credits and features for individual creators and teams.

offers.title: Synthesia pricing starts from $18/month and highlights time and budget savings
offers.description: Synthesia's pricing pages promote plans for Basic, Starter, Creator, and Enterprise teams, with claims of large production time and budget savings.

offers.title: HeyGen offers creator and team pricing for AI avatars, localization, and video APIs
offers.description: HeyGen's pricing and API pages position the platform for creators and businesses creating avatar videos, translations, and scalable video APIs.

offers.title: Descript pricing starts free with paid creator and team plans from $16/month
offers.description: Descript's pricing page frames its AI video and podcast editor as free to start, with paid plans for podcasting, video, and team collaboration.

inspire.title: Runway AI Film Festival 2026 spotlights creators experimenting with art and technology
inspire.description: The AI Film Festival has evolved into an interdisciplinary showcase for artists and filmmakers using AI across storytelling, design, and technology.

inspire.title: LifeArt Festival AI Award celebrates AI-generated films, digital art, and enhanced post-production
inspire.description: LifeArt's AI Award category recognizes creative excellence in AI films, digital art, and AI-assisted production workflows.

inspire.title: One More Shot automates AI music videos from songs, styles, and scene-by-scene project edits
inspire.description: One More Shot lets creators upload music, choose a style, and generate fully synced AI music videos with project-level scene control.

inspire.title: Mootion highlights AI art and design showcases for cinematic storytelling
inspire.description: Mootion's showcase collection points creators toward AI-generated art videos, cinematic storytelling examples, and design-forward motion workflows.
